name: Defines Loopback Address
description: This host's own network stack defines this loopback address (127.0.0.0/8 or ::1). Containment: every machine has its own loopback, so the address exists only as part of the host and retires when the host does (computing_core__host lists this edge in CONTAINMENT_EDGES). Exactly one per loopback_address, drawn to the host whose (realm, stable_id) the loopback_address's host_realm and host_stable_id name.
